description: This Java class defines an entity named DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabs, which models interest rate slabs for deposit accounts in a savings portfolio. It contains fields for interest rate slab details, references to the parent interest rate chart, and associated incentives. The class provides methods for creating instances from domain objects, updating references, and accessing its data. It is part of the domain layer handling interest rate slabs for savings accounts.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabs
classes.description: Entity class representing interest rate slabs for deposit accounts, including relationships to interest incentives and the parent interest rate chart.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabs instance from an InterestRateChartSlab and a parent chart, copying interest incentives.

methods.name: updateIncentiveReference
methods.description: Updates the reference of incentives to this slab instance.

methods.name: setOfIncentives
methods.description: Returns the set of incentives associated with this slab, initializing if null.

methods.name: savingsProductId
methods.description: Returns the savings account ID associated with this interest rate chart.

methods.name: slabFields
methods.description: Returns the interest rate slab fields.

methods.name: updateChartReference
methods.description: Updates the reference to the parent interest rate chart.
